task_completion.description: Open the Weasis medical viewer and load the DICOM image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible showing a medical image (X-ray or CT slice) in the main viewport.

task_completion.description: Use the measurement tool to determine the maximum transverse Cardiac Diameter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or caliper tool is visible across the widest part of the heart shadow with a numerical value in mm.

task_completion.description: Use the measurement tool to determine the maximum internal Thoracic Diameter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or caliper tool is visible across the widest internal part of the rib cage with a numerical value in mm.

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot of the measurements to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent interacts with a 'Save' or 'Export' dialog, or a terminal command is seen confirming the creation of ~/DICOM/exports/ctr_measurements.png.

task_completion.description: Generate the text report with the required three-line format and calculated ratio.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the file ~/DICOM/exports/ctr_report.txt containing the Cardiac Diameter, Thoracic Diameter, and the calculated Ratio.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the Weasis GUI tools to perform measurements rather than hardcoding values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor interacting with measurement icons (e.g., ruler/caliper) and dragging lines over the image.

integrity.description: Verify the Cardiothoracic Ratio in the report matches the division of the two measured diameters.
integrity.visual_evidence: The ratio in the final report is mathematically consistent (Cardiac / Thoracic) with the values shown on the screen measurements.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply open a pre-existing report or image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively typing the report content or using the 'Save As' interface to name the files.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The DICOM file (Rubo Medical 0002.DCM) is actually an X-Ray Angiography (XA) cine loop with 96 frames, though the task refers to it as an axial CT slice. The agent must save the report to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ctr_report.txt and the image to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ctr_measurements.png. The ratio calculation (Cardiac/Thoracic) has a math tolerance of 0.05.
